texts.回馈阵线达到3/4/5/6时，属于自身的召唤物死亡时，召唤者获得25%/50%/: When Return Front reaches 3/4/5/6, when one's own summon dies, the summoner gains a Magic Shield of 25%/50%/75%/100% Power; this effect triggers 1 time per 5 sec. When a summon dies, the summoner also restores 0/0/0/250 Rage; this effect triggers once per 10 sec.
texts.暴怒阵线达到2/3/4/5/6时，暴怒阵线黑卫每次受伤会增加造成的所有伤害1%/: When Rage Front reaches 2/3/4/5/6, each time Rage Front Blackguards take DMG, all DMG they deal increases by 1%/1.5%/2%/3%/3%, stacking up to 5 times, lasting 30 sec. When another Blackguard in the team dies, Rage Front Blackguards have a 0%/0%/0%/0%/100% chance to immediately restore HP and enter a Fury state, increasing the DMG boost effect by 100%. Lasts 30 sec.
texts.流星阵线达到2/3/4时，10秒1次，召唤流星对场上所有敌人造成1000%/15: When Meteor Front reaches 2/3/4, 1 time every 10 sec, summons a meteor that deals Fire DMG equal to 1000%/1500%/2000% Power to all enemies on the field. (Cast by the character with the highest Spell Power in the team)

Lightning chain DMG = extra Rage gained within 5 sec/140*(Spell+Physical) Power. (Extra energy gained: effects such as stealing Rage, skills directly restoring Rage, etc.)
texts.魔导阵线的强度达到2/3/4/5/6时，队伍中魔导型黑卫血量降低至50%以下时，: When Invokers Front strength reaches 2/3/4/5/6, when an Invokers Front Blackguard in the team drops below 50% HP, casts a hex on 1 random target, turning it into a sheep for 1.5/2/3/4/4 sec. Cooldown: 14/14/14/14/8 sec.

texts.妖精阵线黑卫在阵线达到3/4级时，将给队伍中生命值最高的黑卫添加生命之种效果。生: When the Front reaches level 3/4, Fairies Front Blackguards grant the Life Seed effect to the Blackguard with the highest HP in the team.
